definition.gate: Disable selected Core-to-Core edges and cancel their in-flight arrivals immediately after identical baseline, before action; dispose branch after forecast
definition.inference: All variants and controls; seed-paired per mapping/checkpoint descriptive bootstrap, 4000 resamples seed1234, no learning/significance gate
definition.limits: Pair rank is not an independent single-action forecast; motor and non-Core feedback remain; no inference that a permanent block improves learning
definition.preserved: Frozen weights, cellular state and clock at intervention; same visual count decoder, nine action-copy arrivals; all other pathways intact
definition.status: Diagnostic intervention on known M9 checkpoints, not fresh confirmation
